title: run.yipyap.reply.alert.enriched.v1
description: Sent by a sink to attach structured context (links, previews) to an alert's timeline.

alert_id.description: ID of the alert being enriched. Must match ce_alertref on the reply envelope.

items.description: Fields: label (string, required), href (string, optional URL), preview (string, optional text snippet), kind (string, optional category hint, e.g. 'log', 'graph', 'runbook').

attachments.description: One or more attachment records rendered as a "Related context" block on the alert detail page.
